[download.test] Download Browser.createBrowserContext should not download to location
reason: Saves a context's downloads into a directory the caller names, or denies them. Stock WebKit has no downloads: a context with any `downloads` value fails with `Unsupported`, so the port runs these on Chromium and Firefox

tests: [download.test] Download Puppeteer.launch should download to configured location in the default context
reason: Sets the downloads of the browser's default context at launch (`downloadBehavior`). Strider's default context takes no downloads option, and a launch takes none; the nearest matrix row is the launch's downloads path
